### Data & Analytics Systems  
#### Data Warehouse (DW)  
**System ID:** DW-001
**Purpose:** Centralized analytics and business intelligence
**Technology:** AWS Redshift, Apache Spark
**Data Model:** Star schema (facts + dimensions)
**Update Frequency:** Real-time (for hot data), nightly batch (historical)  
**Key Data Marts:**
- **Customer Mart:** 500 customers × 50 attributes
- **Account Mart:** 800 accounts × attributes
- **Transaction Mart:** 2,000+ monthly transactions
- **Product Mart:** 5 products × performance metrics
- **Compliance Mart:** KYC, AML, complaints data  
**Dashboards & Reports:**
- Executive Dashboard (daily KPIs)
- Product Performance Dashboard
- Fraud Detection Dashboard
- Compliance & Risk Dashboard
- Customer Analytics Dashboard  
**Retention Policy:**
- Hot data (3 months): Real-time
- Warm data (1–3 years): Nightly batch
- Cold data (3+ years): Archive (S3)

raw_entities.name: Data Warehouse
raw_entities.description: Centralized analytics and business intelligence platform serving FirstUK Bank's data analysis needs. Built on AWS Redshift and Apache Spark with a star schema data model supporting real-time hot data and nightly batch processing of historical data. Hosts multiple specialized data marts covering customers, accounts, transactions, products, and compliance domains.
context: Update Frequency: Real-time (for hot data), nightly batch (historical)

raw_entities.name: Customer Mart
raw_entities.description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing customer-centric analytics and attributes. Supports 500 customers with 50 attributes each for customer analytics and segmentation.

raw_entities.name: Account Mart
raw_entities.description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing account-level analytics and dimensional data. Supports 800 accounts with associated attributes for account performance analysis.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Mart
raw_entities.description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing transaction-level analytics and monitoring data. Processes 2,000+ monthly transactions for transaction analysis and fraud detection.

raw_entities.name: Product Mart
raw_entities.description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing product performance metrics and analytics. Tracks 5 products with associated performance metrics for product analytics and reporting.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Mart
raw_entities.description: Specialized data mart within the Data Warehouse containing compliance, regulatory, and risk data. Aggregates KYC verification, AML screening, and customer complaints data for compliance monitoring and reporting.
context: Compliance Mart: KYC, AML, complaints data

raw_entities.name: Executive Dashboard
raw_entities.description: Daily KPI reporting dashboard providing executive-level visibility into bank performance metrics and key indicators.

raw_entities.name: Product Performance Dashboard
raw_entities.description: Analytics dashboard tracking and reporting on the performance metrics of FirstUK Bank's product portfolio.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Dashboard
raw_entities.description: Real-time monitoring and alerting dashboard for fraud detection and investigation, supporting fraud alert generation and response.

raw_entities.name: Compliance & Risk Dashboard
raw_entities.description: Compliance and risk monitoring dashboard providing visibility into regulatory obligations, AML screening, KYC verification status, and risk metrics.

raw_entities.name: Customer Analytics Dashboard
raw_entities.description: Customer-focused analytics dashboard providing insights into customer behavior, segmentation, and engagement metrics.

raw_entities.name: Customer Mart Capacity
raw_entities.description: Capacity metric for the Customer Mart data mart, tracking the volume of customer records and attributes maintained.

raw_entities.name: Account Mart Capacity
raw_entities.description: Capacity metric for the Account Mart data mart, tracking the volume of account records maintained.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Mart Processing Rate
raw_entities.description: Processing rate metric for the Transaction Mart, tracking monthly transaction volume processed through the data warehouse.

raw_entities.name: Product Mart Coverage
raw_entities.description: Coverage metric for the Product Mart, tracking the number of products with performance metrics maintained in the data warehouse.

raw_entities.name: Data Retention Policy
raw_entities.description: Tiered data retention policy governing how long data is maintained in the Data Warehouse across hot, warm, and cold storage tiers. Hot data retained for 3 months in real-time, warm data for 1-3 years in nightly batch, and cold data archived to S3 after 3+ years.
